mapper.select: SELECT * FROM suppliers ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO suppliers (name, contact_name, phone, email, tax_code, is_active, note) VALUES (#{name}, #{contactName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{taxCode}, #{isActive}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE suppliers SET name = #{name}, contact_name = #{contactName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, tax_code = #{taxCode}, is_active = #{isActive}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id}
